# Get real-time data & visibility anywhere No Batteries, No Wires, No Boundaries

Energous RF-based wireless power network (WPN) solutions connect businesses with their critical
data, delivering operational efficiency with fewer batteries for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ VIEW OUR PRODUCTS ][39]

### Latest News

Energous Wins “IoT Connected Retail Innovation of the Year” in 2025 IoT Breakthrough Awards Program

[ Read More ][41]

#### Making the Supply Chain Smarter

Energous is transforming how businesses connect and automate their supply chains with our WPN
solutions. Schedule a demo to learn more.

[ Request A Demo ][42]

## Connecting Your Devices, At A Distance

Energous Wireless Power Network (WPN) solutions deliver unprecedented levels of supply chain
visibility, control, and automation, ensuring your items – from pallets to products – are in the
right place, at the right time.

[ About Our Technology ][43]

#### Always On Power

for 24/7/365 connectivity

#### No Batteries,
#### Cables or Wires

for any configuration

#### Streamlined Data Transmission

for real-time monitoring

#### Lower cost of maintenance

for operational efficiency

#### Lower cost of manpower

for increased profitability

#### Higher levels of automation

for improved productivity

[ Learn more about WPNs ][44]

## Building a Wireless Power Network

Energous PowerBridge transmitters are the backbone of WPNs, allowing connected devices to provide
critical data to cloud networks continuously. They deliver an automated energy flow that optimizes
device performance, acting as efficient data links that allow you to analyze, optimize, and improve
every part of your supply chain in real-time.

# Power The Future Today

Cota® Real Wireless Power™ is Available

[[Discover Cota]][24]

[ [scroll-icon] ][25]

## Pushing the Boundaries of Wireless Power

Founded in 2008 by physicist and technologist Hatem Zeine, Ossia is challenging people’s core
assumptions about what is possible with wireless power.

Headquartered in Redmond, WA, Ossia’s Cota technology redefines wireless power by safely delivering
targeted energy to devices at a distance. Ossia’s patented RF smart antenna technology automatically
keeps multiple devices charged without any user intervention, enabling an efficient and truly
wire-free, powered-up world that is always on and always connected.

[tranmistterfront]

### Cota for IoT

[Enable future IoT innovation][26]

Cota is continuous, uninterrupted, energy that fits into tiny, inaccessible spaces, even as small as
an IoT sensor.

Clear the path to innovative product design and features that improve the world of connected things.

Wireless power helps you achieve longer IoT shelf-life with fewer maintenance needs, while giving
you real-time data for continuous improvements.
* Continuous uninterrupted energy
* Power over air even while in motion
* Achieve new streams of real-time data
* Decrease maintenance needs
* Increase shelf life of IoT products
* Facilitate product design and innovation

[Learn more][27]

### Cota for Logistics

[Elevate the efficiency of your supply chain][28]

Wireless power is a supply chain management and logistics operations game changer.

From warehouses to distribution centers, when modern supply chain technology runs on wireless power,
you’ll have more options for improved asset tracking and operational efficiencies.

Wirelessly power scanners, trackers, and sensors and connect to real-time data for deep business
intelligence
* Continuous wireless power enables supply chain digitization
* Achieve more comprehensive asset tracking
* Power scanners, trackers, and sensors over air, while in motion
* Connect to real-time data and optimize operational efficiencies
* Gain deep business intelligence from end to end

[Learn more][29]

### Cota for Retail

[Power the retail environment to bring innovation to in-store shopping experiences][30]

The time for instant inventory updates and an easier shopping experience is now.

Wireless power springloads retail for the innovations required to satisfy evolving consumer needs
and behaviors.

Gain uninterrupted power to sensors, displays, shopping carts, and handheld scanners while managing
a constantly changing inventory in near real-time.
* Uninterrupted power to sensors, wirefree displays, shopping carts
* Omnichannel shopping supports modern shopping needs
* Wirelessly power electronic shelf labels
* Always-charged handheld scanners
* Create easier checkout experiences
* Remotely manage inventory in real-time

[Learn more][31]

### Cota for Smart Buildings

[Open the door to rapid enterprise growth and innovation][32]

Industry 4.0 is well positioned to take full advantage of the benefits of wireless power.

The opportunities are endless, from minimizing the need for batteries, extension cords, and wiring,
and decreasing the work interruptions of stopping to charge, to developing sustainable automated
operations that enable increased connectivity and innovations.

What will your enterprise achieve next with wireless power?
* Make Smart Building Smarter
* Develop sustainable building operations
* Minimize safety hazards
* Maximize employee up-time
* Create more connectivity and innovation opportunities
* Lower the dependence on batteries
* Support the rapid growth of your 5G and IoT systems

[Learn more][33]

## Innovative FCC Certified Technology

[FCC_New_Logo]

 

As the licensing provider, Ossia helps your organization license and build Cota technology into your
devices or transmitters.

The Cota Power Receiver, embedded into any device initiates the ‘conversation’ by sending a beacon
signal (see diagram below) to find a Cota Power Transmitter. The transmitter then sends power back
in the same exact paths. This ‘conversation’ between device and transmitter happens 100x/second, to
send power safely to devices at a distance while in motion. All your Cota-enabled devices will
receive power simultaneously

[[Learn more]][34]

Cota® Real Wireless Power™ is Available

## Pushing the Boundaries of Wireless Power

Founded in 2008 by physicist and technologist Hatem Zeine, Ossia is challenging people’s core
assumptions about what is possible with wireless power.

Headquartered in Redmond, WA, Ossia’s Cota technology redefines wireless power by safely delivering
targeted energy to devices at a distance. Ossia’s patented RF smart antenna technology automatically
keeps multiple devices charged without any user intervention, enabling an efficient and truly
wire-free, powered-up world that is always on and always connected.

[tranmistterfront]

### Cota for IoT

[Enable future IoT innovation][26]

Cota is continuous, uninterrupted, energy that fits into tiny, inaccessible spaces, even as small as
an IoT sensor.

Clear the path to innovative product design and features that improve the world of connected things.

Wireless power helps you achieve longer IoT shelf-life with fewer maintenance needs, while giving
you real-time data for continuous improvements.
* Continuous uninterrupted energy
* Power over air even while in motion
* Achieve new streams of real-time data
* Decrease maintenance needs
* Increase shelf life of IoT products
* Facilitate product design and innovation

[Learn more][27]

### Cota for Logistics

[Elevate the efficiency of your supply chain][28]

Wireless power is a supply chain management and logistics operations game changer.

From warehouses to distribution centers, when modern supply chain technology runs on wireless power,
you’ll have more options for improved asset tracking and operational efficiencies.

Wirelessly power scanners, trackers, and sensors and connect to real-time data for deep business
intelligence
* Continuous wireless power enables supply chain digitization
* Achieve more comprehensive asset tracking
* Power scanners, trackers, and sensors over air, while in motion
* Connect to real-time data and optimize operational efficiencies
* Gain deep business intelligence from end to end

[Learn more][29]

### Cota for Retail

[Power the retail environment to bring innovation to in-store shopping experiences][30]

The time for instant inventory updates and an easier shopping experience is now.

Wireless power springloads retail for the innovations required to satisfy evolving consumer needs
and behaviors.

Gain uninterrupted power to sensors, displays, shopping carts, and handheld scanners while managing
a constantly changing inventory in near real-time.
* Uninterrupted power to sensors, wirefree displays, shopping carts
* Omnichannel shopping supports modern shopping needs
* Wirelessly power electronic shelf labels
* Always-charged handheld scanners
* Create easier checkout experiences
* Remotely manage inventory in real-time

[Learn more][31]

### Cota for Smart Buildings

[Open the door to rapid enterprise growth and innovation][32]

Industry 4.0 is well positioned to take full advantage of the benefits of wireless power.

The opportunities are endless, from minimizing the need for batteries, extension cords, and wiring,
and decreasing the work interruptions of stopping to charge, to developing sustainable automated
operations that enable increased connectivity and innovations.

What will your enterprise achieve next with wireless power?
* Make Smart Building Smarter
* Develop sustainable building operations
* Minimize safety hazards
* Maximize employee up-time
* Create more connectivity and innovation opportunities
* Lower the dependence on batteries
* Support the rapid growth of your 5G and IoT systems

[Learn more][33]

## Innovative FCC Certified Technology

[FCC_New_Logo]

 

As the licensing provider, Ossia helps your organization license and build Cota technology into your
devices or transmitters.

The Cota Power Receiver, embedded into any device initiates the ‘conversation’ by sending a beacon
signal (see diagram below) to find a Cota Power Transmitter. The transmitter then sends power back
in the same exact paths. This ‘conversation’ between device and transmitter happens 100x/second, to
send power safely to devices at a distance while in motion. All your Cota-enabled devices will
receive power simultaneously

[[Learn more]][34]


[Cota Power!] [Cota Power!]

Click on the person or any of the devices and move them around the room. Watch the Cota beacon
signal bounce off of walls and objects while always avoiding the person. Power is delivered along
this same path, while in motion and at a distance.

[Learn more][35]

## Powering the Next Era of Intelligence

Since 2003, Powercast Corp has been more than a wireless power company; we have been the architects
of a wires-free future. In a world increasingly defined by the "AI machine," the demand for
real-time data has never been higher—but that data is only as resilient and plentiful as the power
that sustains its collection at the Edge. We recognized early on that for the Internet of Things to
truly scale, it had to break free from the constraints of the power cord and the logistical burden
of the disposable battery. Today, Powercast stands as the industry's premier destination for
scalable, sustainable power solutions that ensure the Edge remains energized, autonomous, and
permanent.

Our journey is defined by a relentless pursuit of innovation, backed by a global portfolio of over
300 patents and a proven track record of shipping more than 30 million units worldwide. We offer the
industry’s most versatile technology toolkit—spanning from microwatts to kilowatts and short-range
to long-range delivery. By combining our pioneering RF energy-harvesting roots with strategic
partnerships in SmartInductive™ and magnetic resonance technologies, we provide a complete,
customizable ecosystem for our partners. From initial concept and prototyping through to mass
production, we help industries transition away from battery waste and toward a sustainable,
high-uptime data infrastructure. At Powercast, we don’t just deliver power; we deliver the
foundational energy that brings the intelligent world to life.

# Infrastructure for the Intelligent Edge

Powercast EDGE delivers scalable, battery-free power where data is created.

[Powercast-warehouse-nodes-banner]

## Deploy Once. Scale Sustainably.

Powering edge sensors and devices without batteries, wires, or service interruptions.

[PCT300-Black_ServerVertMount_banner]

## Powering the Next Era of Intelligence

Since 2003, Powercast Corp has been more than a wireless power company; we have been the architects
of a wires-free future. In a world increasingly defined by the "AI machine," the demand for
real-time data has never been higher—but that data is only as resilient and plentiful as the power
that sustains its collection at the Edge. We recognized early on that for the Internet of Things to
truly scale, it had to break free from the constraints of the power cord and the logistical burden
of the disposable battery. Today, Powercast stands as the industry's premier destination for
scalable, sustainable power solutions that ensure the Edge remains energized, autonomous, and
permanent.

Our journey is defined by a relentless pursuit of innovation, backed by a global portfolio of over
300 patents and a proven track record of shipping more than 30 million units worldwide. We offer the
industry’s most versatile technology toolkit—spanning from microwatts to kilowatts and short-range
to long-range delivery. By combining our pioneering RF energy-harvesting roots with strategic
partnerships in SmartInductive™ and magnetic resonance technologies, we provide a complete,
customizable ecosystem for our partners. From initial concept and prototyping through to mass
production, we help industries transition away from battery waste and toward a sustainable,
high-uptime data infrastructure. At Powercast, we don’t just deliver power; we deliver the
foundational energy that brings the intelligent world to life.

# Powering the Next
# Infrastructure Layer

Enabling a cable-free digital world
through wireless power transfer

ワイヤレス給電で配線のないデジタル世界へ

[ Read more ][20]

## Technology

エイターリンクのワイヤレス給電は、単なるデバイス向けの機能ではなく、
社会インフラとして拡張可能な「エネルギーのレイヤー」を構成する技術群です。
その核となる伝送方式から、安全性、標準化、知財戦略までを一貫して設計しています。

Our wireless power transfer technology is not just a device-level feature. It is an energy layer
that scales across buildings, facilities, and cities. From transmission principles to safety,
standardization, and intellectual property, our technology is designed as a coherent system.

[ Read more ][21]
[ドット状の青い波]

## Business

[機械が作業をしている工場内の様子]

### Factory
### Automation (FA)

Factory Automation(FA)製造ラインでは、無数のセンサが活用・配線されています。
断線によるライン停止リスクが大きな課題であり、完全ワイヤレスセンサがFA領域のペインを解消します。

[ Read more ][22]
[自動車が道路を走っている様子]

### Building
### Management (BM)

地球上に無数に存在する不動産施設では、温暖化対策をはじめとした有効活用が課題となっています。
後から設置可能な環境センシングによりビルや商業施設の様々な課題を解決します。

[ Read more ][23]
[体内に心臓ペースメーカーが埋まっている様子]

### Medical
### Implant (MI)

心臓ペースメーカーが従来の1/1000サイズに小型化されるー。
そのような未来の実現に向けて、体内埋め込み型医療デバイスへのワイヤレス給電は、当社が長期的に取り組ん
でいく重要なテーマです。

[ Read more ][24]

### 配線にしばられない世界へ。

私たちのワイヤレス給電技術は、製造現場から都市インフラ、そして医療の未来へと、
“エネルギーが自由に届く環境”を広げていきます。

# Powering the Next
# Infrastructure Layer

Enabling a cable-free digital world
through wireless power transfer

ワイヤレス給電で配線のないデジタル世界へ

[ Read more ][20]

## Technology

エイターリンクのワイヤレス給電は、単なるデバイス向けの機能ではなく、
社会インフラとして拡張可能な「エネルギーのレイヤー」を構成する技術群です。
その核となる伝送方式から、安全性、標準化、知財戦略までを一貫して設計しています。

Our wireless power transfer technology is not just a device-level feature. It is an energy layer
that scales across buildings, facilities, and cities. From transmission principles to safety,
standardization, and intellectual property, our technology is designed as a coherent system.

[ Read more ][21]
[ドット状の青い波]

## Business

[機械が作業をしている工場内の様子]

### Factory
### Automation (FA)

Factory Automation(FA)製造ラインでは、無数のセンサが活用・配線されています。
断線によるライン停止リスクが大きな課題であり、完全ワイヤレスセンサがFA領域のペインを解消します。

[ Read more ][22]
[自動車が道路を走っている様子]

### Building
### Management (BM)

地球上に無数に存在する不動産施設では、温暖化対策をはじめとした有効活用が課題となっています。
後から設置可能な環境センシングによりビルや商業施設の様々な課題を解決します。

[ Read more ][23]
[体内に心臓ペースメーカーが埋まっている様子]

### Medical
### Implant (MI)

心臓ペースメーカーが従来の1/1000サイズに小型化されるー。
そのような未来の実現に向けて、体内埋め込み型医療デバイスへのワイヤレス給電は、当社が長期的に取り組ん
でいく重要なテーマです。

[ Read more ][24]

### 配線にしばられない世界へ。

私たちのワイヤレス給電技術は、製造現場から都市インフラ、そして医療の未来へと、
“エネルギーが自由に届く環境”を広げていきます。

NVIDIA's SANA-Video 2.0, a video Diffusion Transformer, efficiently generates high-quality video by

principles. It walks from characteristic functions and the Epps–Pulley test through trapezoidal
quadrature and the Cramér–Wold theorem to the full differentiable loss, using LeWorldModel's
action-conditioned temporal prediction as the running application. Each reduction step is verified
with small runnable experiments, ending with the complete JEPA training loop combining prediction

[ [take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being] ][48]

### [ take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being ][49]

what if form didn't follow function, but pleasure? long before we built anything, we played, turning
a cardboard box into a spaceship and a patch of floor into an ocean. play here is not frivolity, but
our first creative act, the moment imagination learns that reality is negotiable. this chapter
explores what happens when we design not to save time, but to spend it well, rejecting efficiency as
the highest virtue in favor of warmth, spontaneity, and joy. to choose delight while the world feels
heavy is not to look away from it, but to remember what makes it worth carrying.

by sofia lekka angelopoulou

[ [take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being] ][48]

### [ take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being ][49]

what if form didn't follow function, but pleasure? long before we built anything, we played, turning
a cardboard box into a spaceship and a patch of floor into an ocean. play here is not frivolity, but
our first creative act, the moment imagination learns that reality is negotiable. this chapter
explores what happens when we design not to save time, but to spend it well, rejecting efficiency as
the highest virtue in favor of warmth, spontaneity, and joy. to choose delight while the world feels
heavy is not to look away from it, but to remember what makes it worth carrying.

by sofia lekka angelopoulou

# Meet Ether Power.

## The scalable way to *deliver power*.
## Wireless, multi-device, flexible positioning.

44 Granted Patents + FCC & CE Certification

[ Bring Ether Power™ to Your Products ][14]

### “This advancement could reshape how we power everything from computer peripherals to household
### devices.”—Archedyne

# Eliminate cords and even batteries

Charge or power multiple devices simultaneously within an **Ether Power™ Zone**.

No cord clutter.
No battery maintenance.

Power travels safely through-the-air using magnetic resonance, delivering up to **100 watts** within
a WIRE-FREE POWER ZONE™ the size of a desk, countertop, or even a room.

### “This isn’t about charging your phone faster; it’s about fundamentally changing the way we
### interact with our devices. This is a paradigm shift, and frankly, it’s a little terrifying.”

—Memesita

# Powering your innovation

#### Consumer Electronics **·** Retail Displays **·** Bio-Sensing **·** Structural Monitoring

**Etherdyne **partners with solution providers and manufacturers to bring **Ether Power** to
products and environments. We provide the technology and support to deliver wireless power at scale.

With a focus on safety, efficiency, and design flexibility, Etherdyne’s solutions are reshaping how
and where power is delivered.

[ Discuss Your Application ][15]

Devices powered by **Ether Power** can run continuously without having to stop and charge, unlocking
applications that were never practical with batteries.

Imagine…
* Perpetually powered sensors monitoring a building or factory
* Fleets of tiny robots that power up automatically within an Ether Zone
* Electronics in environments where battery replacement is costly or hazardous
* The lightest computer mouse (no battery weight!)
* Watertight cordless devices in the kitchen or bathroom
* Smart homes free from cord clutter

Join our growing ecosystem of innovators building a new class of Ether Powered Devices.

## What’s possible when batteries are no longer required?

[ Join our Partner Program ][16]

*Pacific Northern* launched Ether Powered merchandising solutions. Retailers no longer have to
hard-wire or charge displays, improving flexibility and uptime. [Learn More >][17]

In tech news

  ## and power."
  
  [Yahoo Tech][18]
* ## "Etherdyne carves out a distinct and potentially massive niche. Their licensing model could
  ## position Etherdyne as the 'Intel Inside' of a new generation of perpetually powered
  ## electronics."
  
  [Brief Glance][19]
* ## "Promising applications for such an innovative technology, and it could even be the next step
  ## towards true wireless power."
  
  [Tom’s Hardware][20]

# Meet Ether Power.

## The scalable way to *deliver power*.
## Wireless, multi-device, flexible positioning.

44 Granted Patents + FCC & CE Certification

[ Bring Ether Power™ to Your Products ][14]

### “This advancement could reshape how we power everything from computer peripherals to household
### devices.”—Archedyne

# Eliminate cords and even batteries

Charge or power multiple devices simultaneously within an **Ether Power™ Zone**.

No cord clutter.
No battery maintenance.

Power travels safely through-the-air using magnetic resonance, delivering up to **100 watts** within
a WIRE-FREE POWER ZONE™ the size of a desk, countertop, or even a room.

### “This isn’t about charging your phone faster; it’s about fundamentally changing the way we
### interact with our devices. This is a paradigm shift, and frankly, it’s a little terrifying.”

—Memesita

# Powering your innovation

#### Consumer Electronics **·** Retail Displays **·** Bio-Sensing **·** Structural Monitoring

**Etherdyne **partners with solution providers and manufacturers to bring **Ether Power** to
products and environments. We provide the technology and support to deliver wireless power at scale.

With a focus on safety, efficiency, and design flexibility, Etherdyne’s solutions are reshaping how
and where power is delivered.

[ Discuss Your Application ][15]

Devices powered by **Ether Power** can run continuously without having to stop and charge, unlocking
applications that were never practical with batteries.

Imagine…
* Perpetually powered sensors monitoring a building or factory
* Fleets of tiny robots that power up automatically within an Ether Zone
* Electronics in environments where battery replacement is costly or hazardous
* The lightest computer mouse (no battery weight!)
* Watertight cordless devices in the kitchen or bathroom
* Smart homes free from cord clutter

Join our growing ecosystem of innovators building a new class of Ether Powered Devices.

## What’s possible when batteries are no longer required?

[ Join our Partner Program ][16]

*Pacific Northern* launched Ether Powered merchandising solutions. Retailers no longer have to
hard-wire or charge displays, improving flexibility and uptime. [Learn More >][17]

In tech news
* ## "100-watt capacity of the [Ether] Power Zone could be the game changer for wireless charging
  ## and power."
  
  [Yahoo Tech][18]
* ## "Etherdyne carves out a distinct and potentially massive niche. Their licensing model could
  ## position Etherdyne as the 'Intel Inside' of a new generation of perpetually powered
  ## electronics."
  
  [Brief Glance][19]
* ## "Promising applications for such an innovative technology, and it could even be the next step
  ## towards true wireless power."
  
  [Tom’s Hardware][20]

Fast and Ultra-fast DC chargers in 400V/120kW and 800V/320kW

Wireless technology for high power, high power density and high efficiency.

[(Read for more details)][26]

SiC based compact high performance 3-phase and 6-phase inverters for commercial uses.

High performance motors for traction (EESM), commercial fans (PMSM), and industrial drives (SynRM)

[(Read for more details)][28]

Electrify combustion and hydraulic based drive systems for energy efficiency.

# IoT Leader for Enterprises

## **GAO (Global Advanced Operations) Tek Inc.**

GAO (Global Advanced Operations) Tek Inc. is ranked as a top 10 B2B technology provider in the
world. Headquartered in New York City, U.S. and Toronto, Canada, GAO Tek Inc. serves customers
globally while focuses on the U.S. and Canada markets. We sell through our direct tech sales and
tech support workforce, as well as a strong network of partners located in different parts of North
America.

GAO Tek has worked with its sister companies GAO Research Inc., GAO RFID Inc. and its partners to
research, develop and manufacture a wide range of leading technological products for businesses and
institutions worldwide.  Over the course of 3 decades, the GAO Group of companies have been at the
forefront of innovation and have made significant contributions to the global high-tech industry.

long-range connectivity, ensuring efficient data collection and device management.

monitoring, data analytics, and AI-driven decision-making. Whether managing IoT sensors, tracking
devices, or automation networks, our systems provide secure and scalable infrastructure for
businesses.

rollouts with regional compliance and support.

[F logo]Fathom.ai
Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

### Most Recent EpisodeManaging Complexity in the Age of Mass Customization

[Listen Now][97]

As manufacturers offer more customization than ever before, managing product complexity has become a
critical challenge. Tune in with Dan Joe Barry, Vice President of Product Marketing at Configit, who
explores how companies are tackling the growing number of product configurations across engineering,
sales, manufacturing, and service. He explains how Configuration Lifecycle Management (CLM) helps
organizations maintain a single source of truth for configuration data. The result: fewer errors,
faster quoting, and the ability to deliver customized products at scale.

This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. * Extended operational endurance due to power over fiber system not being subject to corrosion

##### Transmit power through fiber optic cables at deep ocean levels.

**Powering Intelligence at the Edge**

## Powering Intelligence at the Edge

## Edge systems & sensors that provide data require unique communication and power connectivity.
## Beamed optical power and communications extend the reach and availability of edge sensors and
## autonomy through various applications.

## **Autonomous Vehicles**

#### Power beaming delivers power like a charging station for the sky, providing a disruptive new
#### way to distribute operational energy to drones when it is physically impossible, too dangerous,
#### or too slow to recharge them any other way.

#### Contact PowerLight directly to discuss how our Aerial ReCarge (ARC) system can be deployed to
#### power your difficult to reach devices, including flying drones, mobile robots, electrically
#### isolated loads, or remote sensors.

## **Critical Power**

#### Wireless power beaming can deliver safe, more flexible power to reconstitute and turn on that
#### critical infrastructure to support those early disaster relief efforts and provide the
#### foundation for transition to longer term restoration. When disaster strikes our communities,
#### power and communication infrastructure are often the first casualties. 

## **Defense**

#### Delivering operational energy in support of more distributed and multidomain operations is an
#### urgent requirement for the Department of Defense (DOD) and one wireless power beaming is
#### uniquely suited to address.

## **Satellite and Solar**

#### Power beaming enables inter-satellite power distribution. Moreover, space-based solar energy
#### can be transmitted wirelessly to receivers on Earth or relayed to airborne and orbital
#### platforms—eliminating the need for fossil fuels or ground-based power infrastructure anywhere
#### on the planet.

## **Lunar Power Distribution**

#### PowerLight’s technology enables a lightweight, flexible, standardized way to distribute energy
#### that liberates lunar loads from the singular reliance on heavy cables and batteries. Sunlight
#### isn’t consistent (long dark periods), and batteries that operate at freezing temperatures
#### deplete too quickly, and as a result, need frequent recharging.

## **Telecom**

#### Wireless power beaming is a new way to deliver clean, safe and flexible power to 5G
#### infrastructure, accelerating time to market and ROI for network operators, while providing
#### critical new flexibility in the design and deployment of future networks.

## **Marine**

#### Whether deep under sea or on the water’s surface, power transmission is a challenge. Power over
#### fiber and free space power beaming are capable of providing vital energy required in these
#### inaccesible environments.

#### **Marine Power Distribution**

## Features
* Lighter more flexible power distribution over traditional copper cabling
* Power over fiber distribution impervious to salt water environment and pressure
* No RF signature
* System capacities to transfer up to kilowatt-level power over kilometers of distance
* Applicable to numerous load types and power demand levels

## Benefits
* Decreased cable deployment costs and risks
* Increased operational flexibility when using lightweight PoF to distribute power to tethered ROVs
  at depth
* No RF signature means decreased risk of targeting and increased ability for discreet sensing
* Extended operational endurance due to power over fiber system not being subject to corrosion
  degradation in seawater
* Single transmitter can service multiple receivers (1 : many architecture)

## Impervious to Corrosion

Traditional copper power cables are highly susceptible to corrosion in salt water conditions

## Large Load Power Transfer

Up to kilowatt-level power transferrable over long distances and without RF signature

## Power Numerous Devices

From sonobuoys, to SOSUS, to various seabed sensors, power over fiber provides many promising
capabilities in maritime environments

[ Learn More ][17]

##### Transmit power through fiber optic cables at deep ocean levels.

**Powering Intelligence at the Edge**

## Powering Intelligence at the Edge

## Edge systems & sensors that provide data require unique communication and power connectivity.
## Beamed optical power and communications extend the reach and availability of edge sensors and
## autonomy through various applications.

## **Autonomous Vehicles**

#### Power beaming delivers power like a charging station for the sky, providing a disruptive new
#### way to distribute operational energy to drones when it is physically impossible, too dangerous,
#### or too slow to recharge them any other way.

#### Contact PowerLight directly to discuss how our Aerial ReCarge (ARC) system can be deployed to
#### power your difficult to reach devices, including flying drones, mobile robots, electrically
#### isolated loads, or remote sensors.

## **Critical Power**

#### Wireless power beaming can deliver safe, more flexible power to reconstitute and turn on that
#### critical infrastructure to support those early disaster relief efforts and provide the
#### foundation for transition to longer term restoration. When disaster strikes our communities,
#### power and communication infrastructure are often the first casualties. 

## **Defense**

#### Delivering operational energy in support of more distributed and multidomain operations is an
#### urgent requirement for the Department of Defense (DOD) and one wireless power beaming is
#### uniquely suited to address.

## **Satellite and Solar**

#### Power beaming enables inter-satellite power distribution. Moreover, space-based solar energy
#### can be transmitted wirelessly to receivers on Earth or relayed to airborne and orbital
#### platforms—eliminating the need for fossil fuels or ground-based power infrastructure anywhere
#### on the planet.

## **Lunar Power Distribution**

#### PowerLight’s technology enables a lightweight, flexible, standardized way to distribute energy
#### that liberates lunar loads from the singular reliance on heavy cables and batteries. Sunlight
#### isn’t consistent (long dark periods), and batteries that operate at freezing temperatures
#### deplete too quickly, and as a result, need frequent recharging.

## **Telecom**

#### Wireless power beaming is a new way to deliver clean, safe and flexible power to 5G
#### infrastructure, accelerating time to market and ROI for network operators, while providing
#### critical new flexibility in the design and deployment of future networks.

## **Marine**

#### Whether deep under sea or on the water’s surface, power transmission is a challenge. Power over
#### fiber and free space power beaming are capable of providing vital energy required in these
#### inaccesible environments.

POWERMAT TECHNOLOGY

## Wireless Charging Platforms

Powermat Technologies is a global provider of wireless charging platforms and the first to bring
wireless power technology to consumers worldwide.

We enable global innovative businesses to incorporate wireless charging technology into their
products with turnkey solutions that provide everything needed from design to production, including
advanced wireless power solutions for unique use-cases.
[ EXPLORE OUR WIRELESS CHARGING TECHNOLOGY ][40]
[Wireless Charging Platforms][Wireless Charging Platforms]
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW

## Powermat Wireless Power Solutions

Powermat specializes in innovation and designing Qi-certified and custom wireless charging platforms
for Consumer Electronics, Automotive, Robotics, Drones, Medical Devices, IoT, Telecom (5G
Applications), and Industrial Applications, along with a licensing program that includes over 225
issued patents in more than 20 countries and more than 30 currently pending applications. Most of
Powermat's patents are essential for the implementation of the Qi wireless charging standard and
cover foundational inventions.

Our wireless charging technology has been adopted and fully integrated by global market leaders such
as Samsung, LG, General Motors, Flex, Harman International, and Kyocera.

Learn all about how wireless charging works, the benefits, why wireless charging is safe to use, and
more.
[ WIRELESS CHARGING SYSTEMS EXPLAINED ][41]
[Qi-Certified Wireless Charging Technology][Qi-Certified Wireless Charging Technology]
EVERY STEP OF THE WAY

## From Design to Production

Powermat provides everything needed to plan, design, and embed advanced wireless charging into
products, infrastructure, and spaces. We specialize in innovation and creating unique wireless power
solutions according to customer requirements, that include everything from system hardware design to
integration and support.

Powermat's R&D and support also Include end-to-end guidance through the Qi-qualification approval
process - from pre-compliance simulation down to final Qi-standard integration.

## Our Partners

"Working with Voltraware on our e-Bike prototype presented a unique challenge—integrating wireless
charging under the vehicle while maintaining the bike’s design integrity. Voltraware approached the
problem with a practical, hands-on attitude, crafting a solution that met both functional and
aesthetic requirements. They navigated issues like space constraints and alignment with ease,
helping us achieve a charging system that didn’t compromise the bike’s overall performance. Their
technical expertise and willingness to adapt to our needs were key to overcoming the hurdles we
faced, making the collaboration both productive and effective."

## Jerry HuangHHH - Vice President Innovation

"Working alongside Voltraware to establish wireless charging standards for micromobility has been an
exciting and productive journey. Voltraware’s use of AirFuel’s next-gen wireless power technology
has played a key role in shaping our approach to the micromobility market. Their technical
expertise, innovation, and commitment to refining these standards have been instrumental in creating
solutions that are both practical and scalable. Voltraware’s contributions are setting the stage for
widespread adoption of efficient, reliable wireless charging systems, positioning them as a leader

# Power, through the air

# Power, through the air

After 200 years of wires and batteries, the wireless era has arrived.

## An Invisible Power Infrastructure

Eliminating charging cables, dead batteries, and the maintenance burden that limits where technology
can go.

### Infrared Power Transmission

Safe, directed infrared light transmits power across the room. Invisible to the eye. Safe for
everyone.

### Dynamic Beam Steering

Real-time algorithms track devices and adjust beam direction automatically. Multiple devices, one
transmitter.

AirCord™ - Directional infrared beams that deliver power through the air. Safe, invisible, and
always on.

## “Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.”

Arthur C. Clarke

200+

Patents & Applications

10+

Years Deep-Tech R&D

3M

Field Hours

1st

and only commercially available room scale wireless power

and only commercially available room scale wireless power

IT'S HERE NOW

The Encode Wireless Power Kit, our first consumer product, is shipping to customers across the US.

Austin · California

## One platform. Countless devices

Wi-Charge licenses its transmitter platform and compact receiver modules to OEMs across industries,
turning any battery-powered device into a wirelessly powered one.

[Smart Locks]
SMART HOME

#### Smart Locks

Always-on access without battery swaps or surprise lockouts.

[Digital Signage]
COMMERCIAL

#### Digital Signage

Moveable, wire-free displays without battery maintenance.

[Security Cameras]
MONITORING

#### Security Cameras

Continuous power for cameras where wiring is difficult or expensive.

[Electric Shades]
SMART HOME

#### Electric Shades

Motorized shades without opening walls or routing wires.

[Smart Sensors]
IOT

#### Smart Sensors

More sensors, fewer maintenance routes.

[Smartphones]
CONSUMER

#### Smartphones

A future category for over-the-air charging experiences.

[AR Glasses]
WEARABLES

#### AR Glasses

Future wearable designs with less battery constraint.

[Smart Rings]
WEARABLES

#### Smart Rings

A path toward smaller wearables with longer useful life.

[Game Controllers]
GAMING

#### Game Controllers

Future consumer devices that stay charged in the background.

## Powered, in the real world

Wi-Charge is already shipping into homes, offices, and retail floors. From smart locks to in-aisle
displays.

## Empowering the devices of the future

Leading brands across smart home, commercial, and IoT are building with Wi-Charge, integrating
